claim_text: The query-conditional oracle gain is 78.8% at matched accuracy, an upper bound with no learned policy.
notes: Pilot raw CSV not in repository; value transcribed from docs/PILOT_EVIDENCE.md and DECISIONS.md D-007.

claim_text: The pre-registered 5 pp non-inferiority claim is not supported: the one-sided 95% lower bound on A(4)-A(32) is -6.17 pp, outside the -5 pp margin.
notes: Primary P1 result; point estimate -4.30 pp, p=0.2691; not certified.

claim_text: At k=4 the calibrated energy per correct answer is 58.17% lower than at k=32 (95% CI 56.02-60.14%).
notes: Descriptive ratio; the 20% floor is met but the accuracy gate fails.

claim_text: The affine energy model J(k)=24.0759+2.2772k fits the calibrated curve with R2=0.9714 and no lack-of-fit (p=0.2813).
notes: H1 supported.

claim_text: The context-side energy share at k=4 is 0.355 and increases with depth.
notes: H4 supported; G3 pass.

claim_text: The identity gap at k=4 is +0.200 (95% CI 0.168-0.232), so H3 is not supported.
notes: The interval excludes zero; the identity is a diagnostic, not a certification.

claim_text: On the Qwen2.5-1.5B arm, A(4)-A(32)=+2.00 pp (one-sided 95% upper bound +4.90 pp), so H7 is not supported.
notes: Direction is opposite to P1's -4.30 pp; H7 not supported.

claim_text: Block calibration failed on the Qwen arm: k=0,1,2 outside [0.8,1.4] (factors 0.261,0.427,0.537); repeat CV max 80.15%.
notes: Energy contrast on this arm is uncalibrated and uncertified.

claim_text: Uncalibrated savings 1-E(4)/E(32)=91.24% (95% CI 89.93-92.36%) on the Qwen arm.
notes: Uncalibrated; not certified; do not quote as clean energy.

claim_text: On the HotpotQA arm, A(4)-A(10)=-10.80 pp (one-sided 95% upper bound -8.00 pp), so H7 is supported.
notes: Direction matches P1's negative contrast; strong effect.

claim_text: Block calibration missed only k=0 on the Hotpot arm (factor 0.700); repeat CV passed (median 1.32%, max 6.77%).
notes: Energy contrast uncalibrated due to k=0 miss.

claim_text: Uncalibrated savings 1-E(4)/E(10)=23.03% (95% CI 16.74-28.50%) on the Hotpot arm.
notes: Uncalibrated; not certified; point above 20% floor.

claim_text: Exploratory Llama 3B arm peaks at k=4 (A=0.476) and declines; no H7 or certification.
notes: Exploratory reader; weaker reader optimum is shallower.

claim_text: Fixed tax arm: accuracy 0.000 to 0.5867 across k=0..32; no clean k* shift identifiable.
notes: Tax raises a; calibration missed k=0.

claim_text: Per-passage tax arm: accuracy 0.000 to 0.5733 across k=0..32; no clean k* shift identifiable.
notes: Tax raises b; calibration missed k=0.

claim_text: P3 policy: test accuracy 0.4194 at 59.99 J/correct vs static k=1 0.4194 at 59.57 J/correct.
notes: G4 not supported; policy captures -2.46% of the matched oracle gap.

claim_text: P3 oracle gain is 36.80% but the policy captures -1.92%; oracle accuracy 0.6667 exceeds static 0.4194.
notes: Oracle is unconstrained; not a matched-accuracy gain.

claim_text: The coverage model does not describe A(k) generally: R2 is 0.273 (P1), 0.151 (Qwen), 0.879 (HotpotQA), 0.097 (Llama).
notes: Model rejected on 3/4 arms.

claim_text: The Qwen and Llama accuracy curves are non-monotone, so the distractor counterexample is present.
notes: Greedy search is unsafe.

claim_text: The identity gap is +0.200 at k=4 and +0.703 at k=32 on P1; it remains a local diagnostic.
notes: No global optimum claimed.

claim_text: P3 matched-accuracy oracle gain is 28.64% and policy capture is -2.46%.
notes: G4 not supported under a matched-accuracy oracle.

claim_text: At the observed effect, 5 pp certification needs about 7,100 pairs; only the 10 pp margin clears at n=1,000.
notes: Derived extrapolation at observed discordance; 5 pp is the only confirmatory margin.

claim_text: Per-query NVML windows are sequence-dependent: k=0 energy swings with the previous depth, and a continuous replay is within 2% of constant-depth blocks.
notes: Diagnostic; no gate changed. P2 energy reported as a range.

claim_text: Accuracy decomposes as A(k)=R(k)Q(k): recall rises with depth while conditional reader precision falls; the two-stage model RMSE is 0.015-0.024 vs 0.062-0.149 for the one-stage coverage model.
notes: Descriptive mechanism; no gate changed.

claim_text: P3 predictability audit: OOF AUC for correct@1 is 0.733; the answer-presence oracle captures 47.8% on the hashed test split.
notes: Below the 50% G4 floor.

claim_text: Continuous P1 optimum is k*=1.214 with a numerically zero identity gap; the k=4 gap is over-retrieval relative to that optimum.
notes: Exploratory; does not re-adjudicate H3.

claim_text: Ratio-of-sums relative bias is 4.9% at A=0.1,n=200 and 0.4% at n=2,000; mean-of-ratios bias is -98.7% at A=0.1 and -32.4% at A=0.8.
notes: Simulation; supports ratio-of-sums estimand.

claim_text: At the 5 pp margin, the z test rejects at 4.8-6.5% under the null; power at d=-2 pp is 33.9-98.9% for n=200-2,000.
notes: Simulation; nominal 5%.

claim_text: The P1 accuracy contrast is unchanged by context clustering: design effect 0.98 on 806 clusters.
notes: Cluster-robust 95% CI in ci_low/ci_high; cluster SE 1.13 pp.

claim_text: Depth energy is carried by prompt tokens: token model R2 0.902 versus 0.888 for depth; conditional depth coefficient -0.11 J/passage (SE 0.11).
notes: BIC 29,290 (tokens) versus 30,212 (depth); corr(k, tokens) 0.993.

claim_text: Holding the gold passage at rank 1 and adding 31 distractors lowers exact match by 3.73 pp (0.653 to 0.615), evidence of reader overload.
notes: A(1)-A(32) on the gold-first subset; answer already in context, so not a retrieval failure.

claim_text: On the 500 shared question IDs the depth contrast is -2.80 pp for Qwen3.5-4B, +2.00 pp for Qwen2.5-1.5B, and +5.00 pp for Llama-3.2-3B.
notes: Depth tolerance falls with reader capability; Llama interval excludes zero.

claim_text: Cross-fitted selection picks k=4 in all five folds with a held-out saving of 58.13% (SD 1.96); winner's curse is 0.03 pp.
notes: Point-estimate selection rule; distinct from the bootstrap P(k*) gate, which still fails.

claim_text: The P3 policy capture is -9.8% (95% CI -22.8 to -1.8) against the matching no-abstention gap of 7.21%.
notes: The earlier -2.46% divided the same saving by the abstention-inclusive 28.64% gap.

claim_text: Block-to-block energy precision is 1.2-7.0% CV across all seven depths (200-question blocks) against a 20% gate.
notes: Lowest 0.012 at k=32, highest 0.070 at k=1; CV is per depth over 5 blocks.

claim_text: GPU energy per query is affine in depth above the k=0 floor: J = 19.15 + 2.131k, slope 95% CI [2.043, 2.219] J/passage.
notes: Weighted LS on k>=1; intercept 19.15 J [17.64, 20.65]. k=0 floor 8.59 J/query.

claim_text: Serving at k=4 instead of k=32 saves 65.25% of GPU energy per correct answer (95% CI 61.27-69.11) on the block estimator.
notes: Cluster bootstrap over 35 blocks, 2000 resamples, seed 20261115. Absolute J remains a range because G7 fails.

claim_text: The block design reproduces the full P1 accuracy within 0.9 pp at every depth (k=4: 0.459 vs 0.450; k=32: 0.490 vs 0.493).
notes: Run 1's non-monotone curve (A(4)=A(8)=0.65, A(16)=0.53) was a 20-question sampling artifact, not a method defect.

claim_text: G7 fails: the block saving (65.25%) agrees with 1 of 3 registered replay references at the 3 pp tolerance.
notes: Agrees with block calibration (64.30%, 0.95 pp); disagrees with sweep (58.17%) and raw window (68.47%). The three references span 10.3 pp, so no pair could meet 3 pp. Absolute J stays a range.

claim_text: A continuous replay totals 0.847 of the cooldown-separated block sum on median (10 replays, range 0.786-1.036, CV 9.5%), and the depth-resolved replay energy recovers only 0.469 of block energy at k=1 rising to 0.820 at k=32.
notes: Per-depth replay energies are per-query window sums, so the depth dependence is the falsified window bias; it is not scalar-correctable, which is why the prereg forbade a global replay/block factor.

claim_text: The replay/block ratio is not stationary: it falls 0.0216 per replay (R2 0.609, Spearman rho -0.855), from 1.036 on the coolest GPU to 0.79-0.82 on the last three.
notes: A 15% thermal artifact inside one session. The replays are therefore not exchangeable and their distribution describes a transient, not the estimator.

claim_text: H-M1 fails against the replay set: the replays imply a 78.90% saving (range 73.85-80.11) against the block estimate of 65.25%, a 13.65 pp gap.
notes: The replay is not a usable ground truth: its depth-resolved energies are window sums and its total drifts with thermal position. G7 remains failed; absolute J is a range.

claim_text: Session variance is negligible under cooldown separation: between-session CV 2.4-3.5% and ICC(1,1) of 0.000, 0.000 and 0.076 at k=1, 4, 32.
notes: Three sessions x 4 contiguous 50-question segments, harmonised to a common idle of 14.72 W; harmonised ICC is 0.000, 0.008, 0.000. ICC with three sessions is coarse.

claim_text: The absolute energy level carries a 3.3-5.9% between-occasion offset: on identical 200 questions with identical accuracy, the session run reads lower than run 2's replicate 0.
notes: k=1 -4.2%, k=4 -5.9%, k=32 -3.3%, against accuracies of 0.340/0.430/0.480 matching the session run. Not explained by idle, question mix, or accuracy.

claim_text: The savings ratio is stable where the level is not: 66.97, 66.28 and 66.41% across three sessions (0.70 pp spread), versus 65.64% on the same questions in run 2.
notes: 0.92 pp cross-occasion difference. Empirical confirmation of ratio invariance to a depth-common offset, which is why the saving is the reportable quantity.

claim_text: Carryover is not a thermal proxy: gamma = 0.0908 J per depth of predecessor (95% CI 0.0787-0.1030) barely moves to 0.0907 with temperature and clock controls.
notes: Question-clustered SEs, 1000 clusters, t=14.6. A preceding k=32 request adds about 2.9 J to the next. Prereg item 5.

claim_text: Fresh-sample oracle headroom at {1,4} is 3.00 pp (95% CI 2.00-4.10), below the 10% stop threshold, so the position conditions are halted.
notes: Paired within question, 10000 resamples. A(1)=0.389 A(4)=0.455 oracle=0.485.

claim_text: Fresh accuracy reproduces run 2 within 0.4 pp on disjoint questions (A4 0.455 vs 0.459; A1 0.389 vs 0.386).
notes: Disjoint 1000-question frames; level reproduces across occasions.

claim_text: Fresh saving of k=1 vs k=4 is 16.90% (95% CI -2.24 to 32.28); the interval covers zero with 10 blocks.
notes: Cluster bootstrap over 10 blocks. Reported as measured; does not gate Step 2.

claim_text: Distractor dose accuracy rises monotonically (0.382 to 0.528, +14.6 pp); trend slope +3.06 pp per doubling (95% CI 1.43-4.69).
notes: Repeated-measures slope over 4 question-aligned segments, t at df=3. McNemar impossible (A-005); this is the conservative substitute.

claim_text: H-overload rejected: at fixed gold rank 1, adding distractors raises accuracy, so P1's precision collapse comes from gold displacement, not reader overload.
notes: Positional part is inference across designs (position conditions halted by D-035), carried as hypothesis into the dense DiD.
